svg.title: MechCrate ecosystem topology
svg.desc: A browser reaches hostnames such as api.localhost and mechcrate.localhost. One workstation-wide Traefik router, installed by mx router install, reads Host rules from container labels on the shared devmesh-traefik Docker network and forwards each hostname to the running container that claims it. Several mx projects attach to that same network, and only the subset of services you started is up.
